days.title: Northern Reservoirs and Passes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: embalse de Las Nieves
stops.detail: It occupies an area of 22,116 hectares and extends, following the north-south vertical, from the municipality of Galapagar (at the level of the Las Nieves reservoir) to Batres, on the border with the province of Toledo.

stops.name: río Aulencia
stops.detail: In its northern part, the strip expands to integrate part of the course of the Aulencia River, the main tributary of the Guadarrama.

stops.name: embalse de Valmayor
stops.detail: The Valmayor reservoir, formed by the Aulencia, is also included within this natural space.

stops.name: puerto de Galapagar
stops.detail: Along its 50 km length, there is a difference in elevation of approximately 350 m, ranging from 941 m at the Galapagar pass —the maximum altitude— to 600 m in the countrysides of Batres —the minimum—.

days.title: Geological Formations and Gorges
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: embalse del Molino de la Hoz
stops.detail: The Molino de la Hoz reservoir, built on the Guadarrama river —in the municipality of Las Rozas de Madrid—, remains outside of this last legal figure due to its private ownership.

stops.name: falla de Torrelodones
stops.detail: The steepest slope is found in the so-called Torrelodones fault, located in the municipality of the same name —near its border with Las Rozas de Madrid—, which serves as a transition between the aforementioned geological units.

stops.name: Altos del Ahijón
stops.detail: Through this fault, the height goes from 941 m (at the Altos del Ahijón, in the Galapagar pass) to 675 m at the El Gasco dam, located at the confluence of the municipalities of Torrelodones, Galapagar, and Las Rozas de Madrid.

stops.name: Cárcavas del Arenal
stops.detail: Especially unique are the Cárcavas del Arenal, in the municipality of Batres.
